text:

author: PC Gamer
text:

Just uncalled-for.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Elder Scrolls Skyblivion mod faces lawsuit from former volunteer, project lead urges 'Please don't turn this into any kind of witch hunt'
The volunteer team is seeking pro bono legal aid.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Celeste and TowerFall have delisted from Xbox's digital storefronts to support BDS boycott
Director of both games, Maddy Thorson, confirmed the intent on BlueSky.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Final Fantasy 14: Evercold delayed to February, preorders start next week
Surely, one of these is the actual, no joke, FINAL fantasy?

author: PC Gamer
text:

Randomizer and speedrunner settings are up next for the spooky Zelda-like.

text:
The top 10 scariest RPGs I've ever played⁠—and one I'm too afraid to try
Number 6 will SPOOK you (for 1d6 psychic damage).

author: PC Gamer
text:
The votes are in, and PC Gamer readers have picked the scariest game on PC
The final battle came down to Amnesia: The Dark Descent and Alien: Isolation.

author: PC Gamer
text:
'Are we going too far with this?': One of the worst scenes in Outlast had its devs debating whether to add it to the game or not
How far is too far in a universe that constantly pushes gore to its limits?

author: PC Gamer
text:
I spoke to one of the world's only gaming political scientists and he taught me how to avoid getting murdered in Arc Raiders
"Players want to feel like they're powerful and can do something cool."

author: PC Gamer
text:
Dune: Awakening is getting a free DLC that adds a whole new map and swaps out sand for snow
Funcom will also "continue expanding the game" through 2027.

author: PC Gamer
text:
id Software co-director says the Doom developer is 'working more closely with MachineGames than ever' after Xbox laid off 'about half of our studio'
MachineGames is rumoured to be working on a third Wolfenstein game.

author: PC Gamer
text:
How fast do you type, and has playing MMOs improved your typing in any way?
On my touch-type, touch-type telephone.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Anthropic updates Claude to 'steer it away' from letting users clone games following weeks of Steam being inundated with AI slop
Anthropic updates Claude to 'steer it away' from letting users clone other games.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Red Barrels' co-founder is just as confused as we are as to why no one's tried to replicate Outlast's success: 'Honestly, I don't know'
You'd think someone else would've successfully taken gore to the next level.

author: PC Gamer
text:
I'm 100% here for a more grounded, realistic GTA 6, one I believe won't come at the expense of its usual haphazard chaos
I hope Rockstar makes us work a little harder to wreak our usual mayhem.

author: PC Gamer
text:
AI-powered game development is 'leading to an explosion of content,' Roblox says, as it brags about 70,000 games published on its platform in the last 5 months alone
Two days after Steam admitted it has an AI slop problem, Roblox basically bragged about the same thing.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Soulframe opens up for everyone next week as the Warframe devs prepare the fantasy action RPG for one of its 'biggest, most violent' updates ever next month
Verse of the Veilands will radically change the structure of the game so it's easier for new players to follow.

author: PC Gamer
text:
New games in 2027: Fable, Final Fantasy 7, and (maybe) GTA 6 on PC
This is where I'd put the GTA 6 PC release date, if we had one.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Star Trek Online players are holding public vigils to mourn Patrick Stewart
In orbit and planetside, the MMO's player base is honoring its most-loved captain.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Romero Games has a new publisher for the game Xbox abandoned, but its 110-person team is now just 16 devs: 'I needed to basically design a new game that could use as much of that stuff as possible'
Champions adjust.
